PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Must-have utilities and administration tools for dedicated servers
PluginData.Description:
Sens Essentials is a collection of utilities and administration tools for Space Engineers dedicated servers.
- Auto Commands: run any command on a timer, at a time of day, at startup, on a player vote, or when grid count, player count or sim speed crosses a limit. Each one runs a list of steps with delays. - Cleanup Presets: delete grids by name, owner, power, distance from players and many other conditions. Run with !admin runcleanup <name>. - Block Presets: turn blocks on or off, or remove them, across the server. Run with !admin runpreset <name>. - MOTD for every player and for new players, with an optional Steam overlay link. - Info Commands: custom answers players get with !info <name>, as chat, a dialog or a link. - Discord Logging: post log entries to Discord webhooks by level and logger, with pings and rate limits. - Suit Refill for admins, everyone (lobby worlds), or one player for a while. - Commands for grids, entities, teleporting, economy, voting, voxel resets, factions and inactive identities.
Configure it in Quasar under Server plugins. New Discord handlers start disabled, with both levels at Trace. The full guide is in the README on GitHub: https://github.com/buttheadbob/SensEssentials
Also available as a Torch plugin, both builds share the same code.
